Based on my analysis of the codebase:

**1. Where is it guaranteed that no two articles share the same slug?**
`prisma/schema.prisma :: Article.slug` — Database unique constraint on line 41

**2. Where is it computed whether the requesting (current) user follows an article's author?**
`src/application/services/ArticleService.ts :: buildArticleResponse` — Lines 190-192 call userRepository.isFollowing

**3. Where is the authentication token verified on incoming requests?**
`src/presentation/middleware/AuthMiddleware.ts :: authenticate` — Line 25 calls tokenService.verify
